company.name: FABRAIX
company.shortDescription: Fabraix develops adversarial verification tools and security benchmarks for testing autonomous AI agents.
company.description: Fabraix develops adversarial verification and runtime security tools for autonomous AI agents. The company focuses on offensive testing methodologies that actively surface hidden vulnerabilities in complex, non-deterministic AI workflows. Its core product, Nyx, is an autonomous blackbox adversarial harness that probes AI agents for architectural, logical, security, and systemic alignment defects at scale. Nyx simulates real-world threat actors to uncover exploit paths that emerge from agent interactions. Fabraix also maintains ACE (Adversarial Cost to Exploit), a benchmark that applies game-theoretic principles to quantify the effort required for attackers to compromise AI systems. These offerings are used by enterprises, AI operators, and developers seeking to evaluate and strengthen the robustness of AI-powered applications and infrastructure.
